title: Count Occurrences
statement: Write a function `countOccurrences(arr, target)` that returns how many times `target` appears in array `arr`. Use a loop.
prewrittenHints: Initialize a match counter to zero.
Inspect each array item to check if it equals the search item.
Increment your counter each time an identical item is found.
conceptNote: Search and count elements matching a specific target value.
